Nia P: Quick sync after the postmortem - we still need owners + concrete ETAs for the customer-facing pieces: short statuspage line, the longer public incident summary, and the policy for sharing full RCAs.
Carlos V: I can take the statuspage line and a draft of the public summary. Keeping it plain language. ETA: tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Rina T: Support will compile affected accounts and tag SLA customers. I'll have the list by EOD today.
Sasha B: Legal: can AMs hand the sanitized summary directly to customers, or should it route via Support? Also, what gates do we require before handing over detailed logs?
Legal Team: Sanitized public summaries are fine to publish and for AMs to share. Any detailed logs, traces, or content with customer identifiers must be gated: require a signed DSA or approval via security@redwood. We'll provide a redaction checklist.
Carlos V: Good. I'll include a "how to request more" blurb pointing to Support and the DSA requirement.
Nia P: Ops question: publish short statuspage note now or wait until the sanitized summary is ready?
Rina T: Publish a brief status note now for transparency (1-2 lines). Follow up with the longer sanitized summary within 48 hours after Legal signs off.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-122 moved to postmortem by @nia at 2026-03-24T13:02:31Z.
Sasha B: Can we add a recurring checklist item: after every Sev1/Sev2, Product + Legal do a 48h review to decide if the public summary needs an update? Makes sure mitigations/next-steps are reflected.
Legal Team: Agreed. We'll include that in the redaction checklist and provide template language for AMs.
Carlos V: Draft will avoid internal IDs and include a short mitigation statement like "routing adjustments and hotfix applied; permanent fix scheduled."
Nia P: Action items: Carlos -> statuspage + public summary draft by 10:00 UTC tomorrow. Rina -> affected accounts + SLA flags by EOD today. Legal -> redaction checklist + shareable template by tomorrow COB. I'll log these in the action tracker and run a check-in on Wednesday. Thanks all.
